seasons.description: Just dropped and already dominating Netflix charts worldwide—pure, slick adrenaline.
seasons.overview: After four years in prison, Assane is ready to start a new life with his family. But the emergence of a mysterious copycat forces Lupin to return to his most brilliant schemes.

seasons.description: Chris Pratt returns in this relentless, high-octane revenge thriller streaming right now.
seasons.overview: Based on the book, True Believer, Season Two finds James Reece searching for a new purpose after finishing his list. But when the CIA corners him, Reece must clear his name by stopping a resurgent terrorist group that has turned an ally to their cause. In this globe-trotting espionage thriller, Reece will uncover a conspiracy that reaches from Moscow to Langley, even to his own family's history.

seasons.description: TikTok's favorite rom-com is back with unbeatable chemistry and razor-sharp banter.
seasons.overview: An agnostic sex podcaster and a newly single rabbi fall in love, but can their relationship survive their wildly different lives and meddling families?

seasons.description: Sylvester Stallone owns the screen in television's most entertaining mafia drama.
seasons.overview: In season four, Dwight fights to legitimize his empire and protect his crew as corrupt politicians, dangerous new enemies, and a crushing personal loss hit from every direction. However, every hard-won gain comes with even harder truths: about loyalty, leadership and the cost of ambition. Each move drags Dwight deeper into the street instincts he left behind in New York - turning Tulsa into a battleground and Dwight into the one threat no one can afford to underestimate.

seasons.description: The chilling horror adaptation setting social media ablaze—creepy, stylish, and impossible to pause.
seasons.overview: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

seasons.description: Pure animated chaos with a massive online cult following—wild, hilarious, and visually dazzling.
seasons.overview: Follow Blitzø (the 'o' is silent) as he attempts to run a startup killing company in a very competitive market, along with his weapons specialist Moxxie, his powerhouse Millie, and his receptionist hellhound Loona. With the help of an ancient book obtained by one of the princes of Hell, they manage to make their work possible and together they attempt to survive each other while trying to keep their business afloat.

seasons.description: Gary Oldman is unbeatable; the sharpest, most gripping espionage series on television.
seasons.overview: In season six, the Slow Horses are on the run as Diana Taverner embroils them all in a fatally high-stakes game of retaliation and revenge.

seasons.description: Gritty, unpredictable, and brilliantly acted—an electrifying crime saga firing on all cylinders.
seasons.overview: In the second season, the Harrigans struggle to show a unified front as rising rivals threaten their fractured criminal empire – and Harry Da Souza, their street-smart and formidable 'fixer', must walk a dangerous tightrope when tensions within the family intensify. As violence spills into every corner of their lives, loyalties snap, safety proves temporary, and the battle for power leaves no room for mercy.

seasons.description: Still pulling zero punches after nearly three decades—the freshest satire anywhere tonight.
seasons.overview: Join Stan, Kyle, Cartman and Kenny for the historic 29th season of South America.

seasons.description: A gorgeous, star-studded literary triumph delivering powerhouse dramatic performances from episode one.
HBO's gritty sci-fi detective series everyone has been dissecting online all month.
seasons.overview: Follows intergalactic cops John Stewart and Hal Jordan as they uncover a dark mystery.

seasons.description: Non-stop emergencies and wild cliffhangers keep fans screaming on social media weekly.
seasons.overview: Explores the high-pressure experiences of the first responders who are thrust into the most frightening, shocking and heart-stopping situations.

seasons.description: Television's longest-running medical powerhouse still knows how to hook your emotions tonight.
seasons.overview: A drama centered on the personal and professional lives of five surgical interns and their supervisors.

seasons.description: Mariska Hargitay continues her iconic reign in television's most dependable crime procedural.
seasons.overview: Delves into the dark side of the NYC underworld as the detectives investigate and prosecute various sexually oriented crimes, including rape, pedophilia, domestic violence, and the abuses of children, the disabled, and elderly victims of non-sexual crimes who require specialist handling, all while trying to balance the effects of the investigation on their own lives as they try not to let the dark side of these crimes affect them.

seasons.description: Justin Hartley delivers crowd-pleasing action and gripping weekly investigations that fly by.
seasons.overview:
"This is Cyrron. One of six planets in the Mygar Federation. There was a prison break. 218 of the most violent criminals have disappeared into the city of Chicago. Finding them won't be easy - they're not human. Luckily for Earth, neither am I." 218 alien prisoners have escaped from their captivity from a prison in the Migar system. Their warden and guard, an alien named Daggun, followed them to Earth. While they occupied the bodies of humans, their pursuer was forced to create his body based on a model on an advertising billboard. Taking his name from the brand on the billboard, "Cole" was picked up by bar owner Mel, who took pity on him. Unlike the other aliens, since "Cole" didn't have a human body, he has no knowledge or memory of Earth, and is forced to learn everything from scratch.

seasons.description: Dark, intense, and relentless—One Chicago's toughest drama remains essential viewing.
seasons.overview: Detective Sergeant Hank Voight and his elite Intelligence Unit at the Chicago Police Department combat atrocious offences and bring criminals to justice.

seasons.description: Consistently delivering tight, comforting mysteries that millions tune into without fail.
seasons.overview: NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) is more than just an action drama. With liberal doses of humor, it’s a show that focuses on the sometimes complex and always amusing dynamics of a team forced to work together in high-stress situations. From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, these special agents investigate all crimes with Navy or Marine Corps ties.

seasons.description: Heart-pounding rescues and workplace camaraderie that comfort viewers week after week.
seasons.overview: The lives of firefighters and paramedics working for the City of Chicago Fire Department at Fire Station 51, made up of Truck 81, Squadron 3, Ambulance 61, and Battalion 25.

seasons.description: High-stakes action spin-off that delivers satisfying thrills from start to finish.
seasons.overview: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell bent on justice. Using everything she's learned from Jack Reacher and her time as a member of the 110 Special Investigators, Neagley puts herself on a dangerous path to uncover a menacing evil.

seasons.description: Timeless comfort animation that still sneaks in clever, modern laughs after decades.
seasons.overview: Set in Springfield, the average American town, the show focuses on the antics and everyday adventures of the Simpson family; Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa and Maggie, as well as a virtual cast of thousands. Since the beginning, the series has been a pop culture icon, attracting hundreds of celebrities to guest star. The show has also made name for itself in its fearless satirical take on politics, media and American life in general.

seasons.description: Ripped-from-the-headlines courtroom drama that continues to spark timely dinner-table debates.
seasons.overview: A blended police procedural and courtroom drama which employs a two-part approach: The first half of each episode focuses on NYPD homicide detectives investigating a crime—often derived from a real-life headline—and apprehending a suspect. The second half takes place in the courtroom, with the district attorney prosecuting the defendant.

seasons.description: Fast-paced procedural tension that keeps you glued to the edge of your couch.
seasons.overview: The New York office of the FBI brings to bear all their talents, intellect and technical expertise on major cases in order to keep their city and the country safe.

seasons.description: High-stakes medical emergencies and hospital romance make this effortless binge material.
seasons.overview: An emotional ride through the day-to-day chaos of the city's most explosive hospital and the courageous team of doctors that holds it together. They will tackle unique new cases inspired by topical events, forging fiery relationships in the pulse-pounding pandemonium of the emergency room, and through it all, familiar faces from the Chicago Police and Fire departments will intertwine as this third team of Chicago heroes hits the ground running.

seasons.description: Sharp tactical action and complex character dynamics anchor this solid freshman thriller.
seasons.overview: A unique show from creator Rod Lurie about the life of the mob and the FBI.  Mob boss Jonah Malloy (David Paymer) is trying to run his business away from the interference of the FBI, while the FBI is trying everything to bring down his terror team.  Malloy doesn't know is he has an FBI undercover agent, Roy Ravelle (Anson Mount), working for him. Lisa Cohen (Leslie Hope) heads the FBI team, which also include Paige Van Doren (Leslie Bibb), who lost her husband on 9/11.

seasons.description: Jaw-dropping visual storytelling and heart-wrenching sci-fi mystery for dedicated animation fans.
seasons.overview: After the Li Tianchen incident came to an end, the Time Photo Studio returned to a superficial calm. However, the news of Xia Fei's disappearance once again plunged everyone into the crossroads of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's awakening powers, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang gradually uncover the secrets of the Bahati fire case. Cheng Xiaoshi's father, Cheng Weimin, and mother, Shao Yuanyuan, also seemed to have intricate connections to it. As the investigation deepens, Liu Xiao, from a mysterious organization, begins his actions, and the intervention of Bridon police officer Jae adds uncertainty to this quest for the truth.

seasons.description: Heavy-hitting, unapologetic action that delivers exactly what fans crave every single time.
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

seasons.description: Cozy, inventive period sleuthing that charms mystery lovers across twenty incredible seasons.
seasons.overview: A Victorian-era Toronto detective uses then-cutting edge forensic techniques to solve crimes, with the assistance of a female coroner who is also struggling for recognition in the face of tradition.  Based on the books by Maureen Jennings.

seasons.description: A nostalgic comedic reboot bringing vibrant energy and warm laughs to your screen.
seasons.overview: In this spin-off from the popular sitcom The Cosby Show, Denise Huxtable enters her sophomore year at Hillman, alma mater of her parents and grandfather, where she moves into Gilbert Hall and shares a dorm room with 26-year-old Jaleesa Vinson and talkative new roommate Maggie Lauten. Also included in the first season cast were obnoxious and extremely wealthy dormmate Whitley Gilbert, ladies' man Dwayne Wayne and dorm director Stevie Rallen. Lettie Bostic later replaced Stevie as the new dorm director. At the end of the first season, Denise would return home (and to The Cosby Show) after dropping out of college. In the fall of 1988, new students Freddie Brooks and Kim Reese entered Hillman College. Freddie was a "hippie-child" who developed a crush on Dwayne; and Kim, an aspiring med student, became Whitley's new roommate. Giving Dwayne a hard time was his math professor, Col. Bradford Taylor. seasons.description: Irresistibly silly daily entertainment perfect for unwinding after a long, exhausting day.
seasons.overview: Two "Internetainers" (Rhett & Link) go far out and do the weirdest things, giving you a daily dose of casual comedy every Monday-Friday.

seasons.description: Energetic animated family chaos that keeps younger audiences laughing from start to finish.
seasons.overview: Welcome to the Loud House, where life can get pretty crazy. One boy, TEN girls?! Lincoln Loud wouldn’t change it for the world!
